pageDescription: Dropdowns reveal a list of actions or options anchored to a trigger. Content will be refined from Figma frames you share.

anatomy.title: Anatomy
anatomy.description: A dropdown pairs a trigger control with a floating menu panel.

parts.label: Trigger
parts.description: Button, icon button, or split control that opens the menu.

parts.label: Menu panel
parts.description: Elevated surface containing menu items, dividers, and optional groups.

parts.label: Menu item
parts.description: Single selectable or actionable row with label and optional icon.

specification.title: Specification guidelines
specification.description: Menu panel padding and item height will be measured here once the Figma frame is linked.

types.title: Dropdown types
types.description: Interactive previews for trigger styles (placeholder until Figma implementation).

guidelines.title: Guideline
guidelines.description: Use dropdowns to conserve space when there are multiple related actions or options.

rows: Group related actions in one menu with clear labels.
Nest more than one submenu level without a clear path back.
Keep destructive actions visually distinct inside the menu.
Hide critical primary actions only inside a dropdown.

items.heading: Action menu
items.body: Use when several secondary actions apply to one object, such as row actions in a table.

items.heading: Selection menu
items.body: Use when the user picks one option from a short list and the trigger shows the current value.
